requirements.claim: Draw the progress frame, track and fill resources the original engine selects for each public state.
Lay out the progress frame insets and fill extent as the original engine does.
Map public progress normal/inactive and value to the original control state.

assertions.claim: Source-map sentinels: every progress cicn (-10080..-10064, -10224, -10223) and ppat (-10080..-10064) is replaced by a same-size sentinel naming its source pixel; every output pixel of the 378 public rows (18 archives x 21 rows: normal/pressed/inactive/disabled, range splits 50 of 100, 3 of 10 at length 40 (trunc 12, round 13), 1 of 4 at length 40 (odd-length halves, fill L = 9), 29 of 96, -10 and 150 of 100 (DET3), 5 of 5..5 (DET2), normalized 0.57 at length 104 and the default, indeterminate phases 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 9 and inactive/disabled phases) equals the CDEF 5 rule table's source map (progress-rules.mjs); the returned phase, path, I / I_f and split agree; the FB7 COL3 colours match after the default display policy. A second test binds the DECISIONS #10/#11 guards and ProgressIdle. Gate, state, inset, split, frame, slicing, tiling, pattern phase, FB sample points, transfer and erase only; no art colour.
